descriptions.w3d_s4_box_destroy: Releases the box widget property and interface handles, destroys its border string and invokes the base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_s4_box_reset: Stops the widget sound, clears editing and input capture, then restores its held interface.
descriptions.w3d_s4_box_set_position: Updates a changed three-word position and forwards it when the box is ready.
descriptions.w3d_s4_box_stop_sound: Stops an active widget sound and clears its identifier.
descriptions.w3d_s4_box_update_border: Chooses a highlighted, grey or style-specific border name.
descriptions.w3d_s4_box_update_properties: Updates eight property values from editing, highlight and enabled flags.
descriptions.w3d_s4_box_border_thickness: Looks up the border thickness setting and returns its scaled value.
